name: Greavard
description: Greavard, the Ghost Dog Pokémon. Able to evolve into Houndstone. A Ghost type.
pokedex_entries: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.
